body:
I am writing this report hoping to find out what has been happening to me lately.
I have used E on a few occassions, and the first few times it was just amazing, but the last three times I did it, things started to go wrong (physically).
On these ocassions I was feeling fine mentally... There was the love,happiness,well being and a sparkle to everything. I had also smoked a couple of joints. But then I started to feel nauseous...there was involuntary clenching of my stomach and it was a little hard to breathe... But mostly it was the nauseous feeling. Then, all these aforementioned got so intense that I had this EXTREME 'pins and needles' sensation in my body..as in it started to go a little numb. This was when I started to panic..my heart started to beat faster than usual...all of this went on for a half hour and went away... Boy, was I relieved.
The next day my appetite was so screwed..I knew that it was something to do with the e.
Personally, I love doing E every once in a way.. But the last few experiences have gotten me a little shaken up. This is quite sad, considering that I would love to do it again. I am a little overweight, but otherwise I dont think there are any problems with my health and I dont take any sort of medication/anti depressants etc.
